findings.title: Confirmation hides capability-change validation
findings.why_it_matters: A capability change on the final step disabled creation without telling the user which retained limit must be cleared.
evidence: canSubmit includes full capability validation; error rendering previously required validationVisible.
Isolated browser final-step test now observes the specific warning and a disabled create button.
findings.resolution: Display validation on step six; browser verified.

findings.title: Vitest lacks browser-safe resource alias
findings.why_it_matters: The broad shared alias captured the new subpath, preventing two web test suites from loading.
evidence: Full Vitest run reported Cannot find module @zos/shared/docker-resources.
Narrow alias now precedes @zos/shared; all 80 test files and 531 tests pass.
findings.resolution: Add narrow alias and rerun full tests.

advisory_outputs.note: Native CM5 deployment and both service startup orders require a separate maintenance-window check.
Live private Registry/Compose, device reboot, object persistence and isolated backup restore remain unverified.
